run_joint_position_control: run the locobot arm through a sequence of joint positions without path planning
create_robot_instance: create a pyrobot Robot instance for the locobot platform to control the arm
test_set_joint_positions: test the arm set_joint_positions method by moving to specific joint angles with plan disabled
review_go_home: review the locobot arm go_home method that resets the arm to its default position
summarize_main: summarize the main function that commands the locobot arm through target joint configurations
